chunks: So he smashed them up to pieces with the exception of the biggest, so that they may turn to it.
ai.seo_question: Why did God leave the largest idol intact when destroying the idols?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the logical inconsistency of idolatry, where the destruction of smaller idols by the largest one serves as a tangible sign for the people to reconsider their worship. The preservation of the 'largest' idol specifically invites them to question whether it possesses the power to protect itself or the wisdom to be worshipped, thereby leading them back to monotheism.
